class.name: JarCylinderSdf
class.brief_description: A signed distance field (SDF) capped cylinder primitive.
class.description: Represents a capped cylinder as a signed distance field, standing along the Y axis. Defined by a center, a radius, and a full height (centered on [member center]). Combine with [JarTransformSdf] to orient it differently, or subtract it with [JarOperationSdf] to bore straight shafts and tunnels.

members.member: The origin point of the cylinder in 3D space.
The full height of the cylinder along the Y axis, centered on [member center].
